$comment: HELIX, Hermes-boundary and AJ-level capability declarations. JARVIS tool capabilities are imported from JARVIS/core/capabilities.py at build time so there is one authority for those tiers.

capabilities.name: Resolve a contact
capabilities.description: Match a spoken or typed name to exactly one contact; ambiguous matches are returned, never guessed.
capabilities.notes: Resolver port defined in aj/calling.py; no HELIX-side implementation verified.

capabilities.name: Prepare a call
capabilities.description: Resolve the contact and stop before dialing, so the user can confirm.
capabilities.notes: Dispatcher verified 2026-11-13: Aj routes helix.calling_service to CallingService.prepare() with lease/journal/receipt/audit, a real wall-clock timeout and cancellation-aware completion. Execution is in-process via ContactResolver; availability is environment-gated (declared unavailable without a resolver). Does not reach the HELIX HTTP/WS bridge or place a real call. retry_safe/replay_safe stay false.

capabilities.name: Open the phone dialer with a number
capabilities.description: Hand a number to the paired phone's dialer, leaving the call button to the user.
side_effects: UI change on the paired phone
capabilities.notes: GSConnect exports no dialer interface on this machine (verified 2026-11-09).

capabilities.name: Place a phone call
capabilities.description: Dial a resolved contact on the paired phone.
capabilities.notes: Requires explicit approval. No telephony control interface is exported by the current bridge.

capabilities.name: Read call state
capabilities.description: Report the current call state when the bridge exposes it.
capabilities.notes: If the bridge cannot report state, AJ must report UNKNOWN rather than infer.

capabilities.name: Receive incoming-call events
capabilities.description: Surface incoming-call notifications from the paired phone.
capabilities.notes: No telephony plugin interface is exported by the current bridge.

capabilities.name: Answer an incoming call
capabilities.description: Answer a ringing call. Requires a reliable, permitted bridge control.
side_effects: connects the user's microphone to a live caller
capabilities.notes: Auto-answer is not approved; this requires an explicit instruction per call.

capabilities.name: End an active call
capabilities.description: Hang up a call the user asked to end.
capabilities.notes: Never end a call merely because the agent believes it is finished.

capabilities.name: Send a message from the paired phone
capabilities.description: Send an SMS/WhatsApp message through HELIX communications.
side_effects: visible message to a third party
capabilities.notes: tools/whatsapp.py exists in HELIX; delivery was not verified in this phase.

capabilities.name: Execute a skill through the runtime
capabilities.description: Run one approved skill via the execution port. The port reports unavailable until Hermes is attached.
capabilities.notes: HERMES INTEGRATION NOT ATTACHED. Requires the owner's HERMES GREEN SIGNAL.

capabilities.name: Delegate to a sub-agent
capabilities.description: Hand a bounded task to JARVIS or HELIX with a task record and policy decision.
capabilities.notes: No AJ delegation dispatcher exists: the executor routes internal: adapters, the HERMES execution port, and agent adapters. AJ owns no agent adapter, so delegation by this id fails with agent_unavailable. Delegate through jarvis.* / helix.* ids instead. Verified 2026-11-11.
